rounds: Social media has done my generation more harm than good.
Parents should be able to read their 14-year-old’s messages.
I would scan my face to keep using my favourite app.
People should have to use their real names on social media.
If you have nothing to hide, you have nothing to fear.
Privacy online is already dead, so there’s little point worrying about it.
Teenagers are more sensible online than most adults.
Smartphones should only be sold to people over 14.
